sections.heading: A Hands-On Day
sections.body: Most of a trainee's day is spent in the workshop, kitchen, computer lab, or farm unit rather than a lecture hall — working on real jobs for real customers under an instructor's supervision.

sections.heading: Community
sections.body: Trainees train alongside peers from many academic backgrounds, ages, and parts of East Uganda, guided by the Institute's shared values of discipline, team spirit, and self-reliance.

sections.heading: Beyond the Workshop
sections.body: As industrial attachment approaches (after a minimum of 9 months), trainees prepare for placement with an external industry partner — a first real step from the classroom into the workplace.
